add.title: US Midterm Elections 2026 – Democrats Win Both Houses
add.md:
# US Midterm Elections (3 November 2026)
- **What:** mid-term elections halfway through **President Donald Trump's** second term – all **435 House** seats and about a third of the **Senate**, plus state governors.
- **Result:** the **Democratic Party** won **control of both the House and the Senate** (AP race calls, 4 Nov 2026), ending the Republican **"trifecta"** (White House + Senate + House).
  - **Senate:** Republicans went in with **53–47**; Democrats reported **7 flips** – North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, **Texas**, Kansas, Iowa, Maine – and held Georgia.
  - **House:** Democrats crossed the majority mark (218 of 435), including seats in redrawn Florida districts and Pennsylvania swing seats.
- **New leaders (from January 2027):** **Hakeem Jeffries** (New York) set to be **Speaker** – the **first Black Speaker**; **Chuck Schumer** to be Senate **Majority Leader** (replacing Republican **John Thune**).
- **Why:** cost of living, tariffs and the **Iran war** (from Feb 2026) pulled down Trump's approval (below 40%), giving a "blue wave".
- **Effect – divided government:** Trump keeps the **veto**; the Senate can slow **judicial and Cabinet confirmations**; House committees gain **oversight/investigation** powers.
- **Constitutional basics:** House term **2 years**, Senate **6 years** (one-third elected every 2 years); the new (120th) Congress meets on **3 January 2027** (**20th Amendment**).
- **India angle:** Congress shapes tariffs, sanctions (e.g., Russian oil), **H-1B/green-card** rules and defence deals; a Democratic Congress may scrutinise Trump's tariff and immigration orders that hit India.
> Exam angle: "midterm" = elections in the middle of a presidential term; both chambers flipped to the Democrats in Nov 2026; Jeffries = first Black Speaker (designate).
> Trap: the President is not elected in a midterm; the Senate majority leader, not the Vice-President, runs the Senate floor.
~~ Sources: opb.org/NPR (AP race calls, 4 Nov 2026); washingtonexaminer.com takeaways; wftv.com/Cox (Democrats capture both chambers)

add.title: Red Fort Car Blast 2025 – White-collar Terror Module and NIA Case
add.md:
# Red Fort Car Blast, Delhi (10 November 2025)
- **What:** a **vehicle-borne IED (VBIED)** in a car exploded near the **Red Fort Metro Station** (Lal Qila area, Old Delhi) on the evening of **10 November 2025**.
  - Official death toll **11** (some hospital reports said 12+); many injured – the deadliest terror attack in Delhi in over a decade.
- **Bomber:** **Dr Umer (Umar) Un Nabi** of **Pulwama**, a former Assistant Professor of Medicine at **Al-Falah University, Faridabad (Haryana)**; died in the blast.
- **"White-collar" terror module:** the same day J&K Police with Haryana Police busted a module of **doctors** linked to Faridabad; about **2,900 kg** of explosive material (mainly **ammonium nitrate**) seized.
  - The NIA chargesheet says the accused followed the ideology of **Ansar Ghazwat-ul-Hind (AGuH)**, an offshoot of **Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS)**; explosive named as **TATP** (triacetone triperoxide).
- **Response:** the Union Cabinet passed a resolution calling it a **terror incident**; the **NIA** took over the case.
- **Nowgam blast (14 Nov 2025):** explosives seized from the Faridabad module went off **by accident** while being sampled at the **Nowgam police station, Srinagar** – **9 killed**, about 30 injured.
- **NIA chargesheet (14 May 2026):** about **7,500 pages**, **10 accused** (incl. Dr Muzamil Shakeel, Dr Adeel Ahmed Rather, Dr Shaheen Saeed, Mufti Irfan Ahmad Wagay), filed at the **NIA Special Court, Patiala House, New Delhi**; the case against the dead bomber is to abate.
  - Laws invoked: **UAPA 1967**, **BNS 2023**, **Explosive Substances Act 1908**, **Arms Act 1959**, Prevention of Damage to Public Property Act 1984.
  - Investigators flagged misuse of online shopping and **AI platforms** to source chemicals and bomb-making know-how.
- **Issues raised:** **radicalisation of educated professionals**; regulation of ammonium nitrate (an "explosive" under the **Ammonium Nitrate Rules 2012**); checks on private universities (Al-Falah faced regulatory and ED action).
> Exam angle: VBIED + "white-collar" doctor module + AGuH (AQIS offshoot) + Nowgam accidental blast (Srinagar, 14 Nov 2025) – don't mix up Nowgam with the Red Fort site.
> Trap: AQIS/AGuH, not LeT or JeM, is the group named in the NIA chargesheet.
~~ Sources: theweek.in (NIA chargesheet, 14 May 2026); gulfnews.com; deccanherald.com; scroll.in and thequint.com (Nowgam blast, Nov 2025)
